# HMS 故障码 / HMS codes · 1A

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| `HMS 1A00-0100-0001-0040` | 感应热端挂架槽位 1 位置霍尔传感器断路，请参照Wiki排查。 | Open circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 1 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0001-0041` | 感应热端挂架槽位 1 位置霍尔传感器短路，请参照Wiki排查。 | Short circuit detected in the Hall sensor at the Induction Hotend Rack slot 1 position. Please refer to the Wiki for troubleshooting. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0001` | 取放挂架槽位 1 热端时发生异常，请保证感应热端固定槽上无热端，对应挂架槽位上有热端，并手动将工具头移动到机器中央后再继续。 | Error fetching/nesting the hotend in rack slot 1. Ensure the hotend holder has no hotend installed, the corresponding rack slot contains a hotend, and manually move the toolhead to the machine center before continuing. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0002` | 取放挂架槽位 1 热端时发生异常，请保证感应热端固定槽上有热端，对应挂架槽位上无热端，并手动将工具头移动到机器中央后再继续。 | Error fetching/nesting the hotend in rack slot 1. Ensure the hotend holder has a hotend installed, the corresponding rack slot is empty, and manually move the toolhead to the machine center before continuing. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0003` | 在更换感应热端前检测到错误，挂架位置 1 未安装热端。 | Error detected before induction hotend replacement: no hotend installed in slot 1 on the rack. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0004` | 在更换感应热端前检测到错误，挂架位置 1 已安装热端，请先取下该热端后再继续。 | Error detected before induction hotend replacement: a hotend is already installed in slot 1 on the rack. Please remove it before continuing. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0020` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：该位置已安装热端，请先取下现有热端后再点击“继续”。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: a hotend is already installed. Please remove the existing one before clicking “Continue.” |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0021` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：工具头上未安装热端，请将热端装到工具头上后点击“继续”。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: no hotend detected on the toolhead. Please mount the hotend onto the toolhead before clicking “Continue.” |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0022` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常，请确保工具头上未安装热端，且热端挂架 1 位置已有热端，然后点击“继续”。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1. Please ensure no hotend is mounted on the toolhead and that a hotend is present in slot 1 on the rack before clicking “Continue.” |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0023` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未识别到工具头上的热端。请检查热端散热片表面是否有异物或前端磁铁是否脱落，若无异常，请重新标定感应热端挂架。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: the rack failed to detect the hotend on the toolhead. Please check whether there is any debris on the hotend heatsink surface or if the front magnet has fallen off. If not, recalibrate the induction hotend rack. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0024` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架未能从工具头上成功取下热端，请确保锁紧拉柄已处于拉开状态。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: the rack failed to detach the hotend from the toolhead. Please make sure the locking lever is in the released position. |
| `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0025` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：热端掉落。请检查热端顶部是否有过长的残余耗材，剪断残料后，将热端重新安装到挂架 1 位置，然后点击“继续”。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: the hotend has dropped. | `HMS 1A00-0100-0002-0026` | 放置 1 槽位热端时检测到异常：挂架运动受阻。请检查是否有异物，清除后点击“继续”。 | Abnormal condition detected while nesting the hotend in slot 1: rack movement is blocked. Please check for any foreign objects, remove them, and then click “Continue.” |
